title: FinAutoRubric: Expert-Guided Automatic Rubric Generation for Evaluating Financial Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.35744v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating finance research agents requires rubrics that reflect expert standards and fix the values correct as of an information cutoff. Expert-reviewed finance benchmarks rely on fixed, per-item rubrics, which are costly to extend and cannot encode each institution's own standard. In FinAutoRubric, experts specify reusable evaluation guidance, while agents and code carry out query-specific rubric generation, review, and validation. This expert guidance governs every agent, as prompts and as rules that code enforces, and a Task Bank of reusable criteria carries it across tasks. In long-horizon loops that follow the expert guidance, a writer agent researches every expected value and a reviewer agent verifies it, and failures escalate to a human. translated_title: FinAutoRubric：专家引导的自动评分准则生成方法，用于评估金融研究智能体
translated_abstract: 评估金融研究智能体需要既反映专家标准、又固定信息截止日期时点正确取值的评分准则（rubric）。经专家审校的金融基准依赖于固定的、逐条目的评分准则，这不仅扩展成本高昂，也无法编码各机构自身的标准。在 FinAutoRubric 中，专家制定可复用的评估指导原则，而智能体和代码则执行针对具体查询的评分准则生成、审查与验证。这些专家指导通过提示词以及代码强制执行的规则来约束每一个智能体，并通过一个承载可复用准则的任务库跨任务传递。在遵循专家指导的长周期循环中，一个“撰写者”智能体负责研究每个预期取值，一个“审查者”智能体验证该取值，失败情况会上报给人类专家。在三个由专家撰写的金融基准上，其评分准则与专家评分的贴合程度与最强的受评估生成器相当，同时能为更多准则给出专家评分准则所对应的预期取值。
tldr: FinAutoRubric 提出一种专家引导的自动评分准则生成框架，专家只需提供可复用的评估指导原则，由撰写者与审查者智能体及代码在长周期循环中完成针对具体查询的准则生成、验证与人工升级，其生成的准则在三个专家级金融基准上的评分与专家评分高度一致，且能为更多准则给出预期取值。
en_tdlr: FinAutoRubric proposes an expert-guided automatic rubric generation framework where experts supply reusable evaluation guidance while writer and reviewer agents, governed by prompts and code-enforced rules, generate and validate query-specific rubrics in long-horizon loops, achieving expert-level scoring fidelity on three finance benchmarks.
